# Day 3 — Uncertainty Extended and Expected / Calculus

Day 3 runs two math sessions. **Session 1 — Uncertainty Extended and
Expected** covers combinatorics, random variables, expectation algebra,
and conditional expectation (the type-shift). **Session 2 — Calculus**
covers limits, differentiation and optimization (first-order conditions),
and integration basics. Programming continues exploring R's data
structures (factors, data frames), conditionals, and descriptive
statistics.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
